title: 第23章 碧灵桃成熟稻蝗虫第24章 出售资源
content_zh:
在接下来的十天时间里，李家派出的两位族人执行着巡逻任务，而黑甲虫的踪影却未再出现。
这使得李家愈发确信，先前的虫害并非自然发生，而是有人蓄意为之。
与此同时，在青元坊市一处隐蔽的小院内，一名身穿黑袍、面容遮掩的修士恭敬地站立在一位青年面前，汇报道：
“空前辈，李家已经加强了警戒，派遣修士每日在岛上巡逻，我找不到机会接近灵田释放黑甲虫。”
青年闻言，神情平静，并未表现出过多的惊讶。
他思索片刻后，提出了新的方案：“既然如此，那就改变战术，使用另一种灵虫——稻蝗虫。
这种灵虫可以从远处释放，专门啃食灵田中的灵米。
待李家的灵米即将成熟之时，你只需在远处大面积投放即可。”
说罢，青年从怀中取出一只早先备好的御兽袋，递给了面前的黑袍修士。
“这……好吧，但在完成此事之后，我希望您能履行诺言，将我的道侣和孩子安全归还。”黑袍修士提出了自己的条件。
青年淡淡地回应：“可以，只要你此次任务完成，我会立即让他们与你会合。”
得到了满意的答复后，黑袍修士接过御兽袋，转身离开了这座小院。
琉璃群岛，风林岛。
随着为期十日的例行巡逻悄然落幕，李家再次迎来了片刻的宁静。
然而，这份宁静之下却暗流涌动。
几位族人伫立于风清草的灵田旁，眼中带着忧虑与无奈。
遭受虫害无情的摧残，风清草的叶片上满是斑驳的痕迹。
李松鹤望着这一幕，不由自主地叹了口气，声音中带着些许惋惜：
“这些被黑甲虫啃噬过的风清草，显然已经失去了大半生机。
即便日后能够勉强成熟，恐怕也只能换得寥寥几枚灵石。”

一旁的李林燕听闻此言，更是愤懑不已，附和道：
“父亲所言极是，真不知道是哪个居心叵测之人放出了这些黑甲虫，实在是太过分了！”
然而，正是这番话令在场的李衍道与李松鹤眉头几乎同时皱了起来，目光交汇在了一起。
李衍道面色凝重，低声向李松鹤传音：“爷爷，此事恐怕与空家脱不了干系。
上次他们纠集了一批散修，企图夺取我们李家的风林岛，这次的黑甲虫事件，背后很可能也是他们的手笔。”
“估计错不了，”李松鹤回应道，语气中带着几分笃定，“我师尊早已嘱咐青元坊市中的筑基期修士，这风林岛由他亲自庇护。
然而，总有些人想要暗中使绊子，阻挠我们获取足够的灵石以供上交，进而破坏我与师尊之间的关系。”
李衍道闻言，眼神闪烁，似乎已有了对策。
他沉吟片刻后说道：“此事并非无解。
若我们安排族人持续巡逻一年，便能有效防范那些别有用心之徒的侵扰。
到那时，会产出大量的碧灵桃。加上族内现有的灵石储备，足以购入一套一阶上品的防御阵法。
有了这阵法的守护，那些妄图施放虫害的修士将无法轻易接近风林岛。”
李松鹤听罢，眉宇间的忧愁似乎有所缓解，点头赞同道：“此计甚妙，就这么办吧。
你大伯他们平日里除了照料灵鱼之外，并无太多事务缠身，正好可以借此机会，让他们专心负责接下来一年的巡逻任务。”
随即，李松鹤将岛上所有人员召集至一处，除了李家的八位族人外，还包括了周鸿瑜及其爷爷。
在众人的注视下，李松鹤清了清嗓子，开始正式宣布即将实施的计划。
“各位族人，为了保障我们家族灵米与灵植的安全，防止再次遭受不明侵害。
经家族商议，决定在未来的一年内加强岛上的巡逻力度。
对于参与巡逻的族人，我们将额外发放十块灵石作为奖励。
现在，凡是达到练气中期以上的族人均可报名参加。”

话音刚落，人群中立刻响起一阵积极的响应。
content_en:
In the next ten days, the two tribesmen sent by the Li family performed patrol missions, but the black beetle did not appear again.
This made the Li family more and more convinced that the previous pest infestation did not occur naturally, but was deliberately caused by someone.
At the same time, in a secluded courtyard in Qingyuanfang City, a monk wearing a black robe and covering his face stood respectfully in front of a young man and reported:
"Senior Kong, the Li family has stepped up their vigilance and sent monks to patrol the island every day. I can't find a chance to approach the spiritual field and release the black beetle."
When the young man heard this, his expression was calm and he did not show too much surprise.
After thinking for a moment, he proposed a new plan: "In this case, let's change the tactics and use another spiritual insect - rice locust.
This kind of spiritual insect can be released from a distance and specially eats the spiritual rice in the spiritual field.
When the Li family's spiritual rice is about to mature, you only need to put it in a large area in the distance. "
After saying that, the young man took out a beast-control bag that he had prepared earlier from his arms and handed it to the black-robed monk in front of him.
"This... okay, but after completing this matter, I hope you can fulfill your promise and return my Taoist companion and child safely." The black-robed monk put forward his own conditions.
The young man responded calmly: "Yes, as long as you complete this mission, I will let them meet you immediately."
After receiving a satisfactory answer, the black-robed monk took the beast-control bag, turned around and left the small courtyard.
Liuli Islands, Fenglin Island.
As the ten-day routine patrol quietly came to an end, the Li family once again ushered in a moment of tranquility.
However, there is an undercurrent surging beneath this tranquility.
Several tribesmen stood beside Feng Qingcao's spiritual field, with worry and helplessness in their eyes.
Suffering mercilessly from insect pests, the leaves of Fengqingcao are covered with mottled marks.
Li Songhe looked at this scene and sighed involuntarily, with a little regret in his voice:
“These wind grasses that have been gnawed by black beetles have obviously lost most of their vitality.
Even if I can barely mature in the future, I'm afraid I can only exchange for a few spiritual stones. "
Li Linyan on the side became even more angry when she heard this and echoed:
"What my father said is absolutely true. I really don't know who has ulterior motives who released these black beetles. It's really too much!"
However, it was these words that caused Li Yandao and Li Songhe present to frown almost at the same time, and their eyes met.
Li Yandao looked solemn and whispered to Li Songhe: "Grandpa, I'm afraid this matter has something to do with the Kong family.
Last time they gathered a group of casual cultivators in an attempt to seize our Li family's Fenglin Island. It is likely that they were behind the Black Beetle incident this time. "
"I guess I can't be wrong," Li Songhe responded, with some certainty in his tone, "My master has already told the foundation-building monks in Qingyuanfang City to personally protect Fenglin Island.
However, there are always some people who want to secretly hinder us from obtaining enough spiritual stones to hand over, thus damaging the relationship between me and Master. "
When Li Yandao heard this, his eyes flickered, and he seemed to have a countermeasure.
He pondered for a moment and then said: “This matter is not unsolvable.
If we arrange for clan members to patrol continuously for a year, we can effectively prevent intrusions from those with ulterior motives.
By then, a large amount of biling peaches will be produced. Coupled with the existing spiritual stone reserves in the clan, it is enough to purchase a set of first-class high-grade defensive formations.
With the protection of this formation, those monks who attempt to spread insect pests will not be able to approach Fenglin Island easily. "
After hearing this, Li Songhe's sorrow seemed to have eased, and he nodded in agreement: "This is a great plan, let's do it this way.
Apart from taking care of the spirit fish, your uncle and the others don't have much to do on weekdays. It's a good opportunity to let them concentrate on patrolling for the next year. "
Immediately, Li Songhe summoned all the people on the island to one place. In addition to the eight members of the Li family, they also included ZhouHongyu and his grandfather.
Under everyone's gaze, Li Songhe cleared his throat and began to formally announce the upcoming plan.
“Dear clan members, in order to protect the safety of our family’s Lingmi and Lingzhi, and prevent them from suffering unknown infringement again.
After family discussions, it was decided to strengthen patrols on the island in the next year.
For the tribesmen who participate in the patrol, we will issue an additional ten spiritual stones as rewards.
Now, any clan member who has reached the middle stage of Qi training or above can sign up to participate. "
As soon as he finished speaking, there was a positive response from the crowd.
